details: picklescan before 0.0.22 only considers standard pickle file extensions in the scope for its vulnerability scan. An attacker could craft a malicious model that uses Pickle and include a malicious pickle file with a non-standard file extension. Because the malicious pickle file inclusion is not considered as part of the scope of picklescan, the file would pass security checks and appear to be safe, when it could instead prove to be problematic.

A vulnerability in the GraphCypherQAChain class of langchain-ai/langchain-community version 0.2.5 allows for SQL injection through prompt injection. This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized data manipulation, data exfiltration, denial of service (DoS) by deleting all data, breaches in multi-tenant security environments, and data integrity issues. Attackers can create, update, or delete nodes and relationships without proper authorization, extract sensitive data, disrupt services, access data across different tenants, and compromise the integrity of the database.

cna.title: knownhost callback mismatches key as missing

descriptions.value:
When libcurl uses libssh2 with a hashed `known_hosts` file, an unrelated
initial entry can cause host key validation to report a key *mismatch* as a
*missing* key to the `CURLOPT_SSH_KEYFUNCTION` callback.

descriptions.description: CWE-295 Improper Certificate Validation

cna.title: IMAP APPEND plus CRLF conversion command injection

descriptions.value:
Enabling `CURLOPT_CRLF` causes curl to advertise the raw input byte count in
the `IMAP APPEND {N}` literal while transmitting line-ending expanded data.
The server reads only $N$ bytes for the payload, causing the remaining
overflow bytes to be interpreted and executed as pipelined IMAP commands
within the authenticated session.

descriptions.description: CWE-130 Improper Handling of Length Parameter Inconsistency

cna.title: HSTS response erases persisted entries

descriptions.value:
An authenticated HTTPS origin can supply an HSTS `max-age` value that the
parser accepts, but time serialization later fails to process. On 64-bit
systems, extreme max-age values compute an absolute expiry within standard
time integer limits that exceeds calendar time structure bounds. During cache
saves, the original HSTS file is truncated before writing a temporary
replacement; when serialization fails, the temporary file is deleted, leaving
an empty or partial cache. Because the save error is silently ignored during
cleanup, curl exits successfully despite the data loss.

descriptions.description: CWE-201 Information Exposure Through Sent Data

cna.title: HSTS cache import drops longer-lived child

descriptions.value:
Importing a `includeSubDomains` parent HSTS entry before a longer-lived child
entry, silently drops the child. Consequently, when the parent expires, the
child's valid HSTS policy is lost, causing curl to issue unencrypted HTTP
requests rather than upgrading to HTTPS.

descriptions.description: CWE-201 Information Exposure Through Sent Data
CWE-201 Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data

cna.title: cross-origin reuse of a Negotiate connection

descriptions.value:
When using ambient user credentials, an HTTP request directed to one origin
may be dispatched over a connection previously authenticated via Negotiate for
a different origin, leaving the request's intended credentials unused.

descriptions.description: CWE-201 Information Exposure Through Sent Data
CWE-201 Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data

cna.title: auto client cert connection reuse mixup

descriptions.value:
libcurl's connection cache match function never considers the automatic client
certificate option, so a cached, already authenticated Schannel connection can
be handed to a transfer that got redirected to a different origin, even though
the code explicitly switched off the auto client cert option for that transfer
to prevent exactly this.

descriptions.description: CWE-201 Information Exposure Through Sent Data
CWE-201 Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data

cna.title: leaking host credentials to HTTP proxy

descriptions.value:
An HTTP proxy can trick libcurl into sending the origin's credentials (Basic
password, or a Negotiate/Kerberos ticket) to the proxy itself, by answering
the `CONNECT` tunnel request with 401 `WWW-Authenticate:` instead of the
expected 407 `Proxy-Authenticate:`.

descriptions.description: CWE-201 Information Exposure Through Sent Data
CWE-201 Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data

cna.title: Negotiate credentials sent to redirected origin

descriptions.value:
When using an *ambient user* in a first transfer doing Negotiate
authentication and asked to follow redirects, curl could pass on its
credential details to an unrelated second origin when asked to redirect there.

descriptions.description: CWE-201 Information Exposure Through Sent Data
CWE-201 Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data

cna.title: SQLite before 3.54.0 Stack Exhaustion via countOfViewOptimization() in VALUES Clause

descriptions.value: SQLite before 3.54.0 contains a stack exhaustion vulnerability in countOfViewOptimization() that allows attackers to crash the host process via count(*) over a large multi-row VALUES clause. Attackers supplying SQL or a database file with a crafted view can trigger deeply nested TK_PLUS expressions whose recursive freeing in sqlite3ExprDeleteNN() exhausts the C stack, causing denial of service.

descriptions.description: Uncontrolled Recursion

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: SQLite before 3.54.0 Stack Exhaustion via countOfViewOptimization() in VALUES Clause

cna.title: SQLite CLI through 3.54.1 Command Injection via .recover Output

descriptions.value: SQLite command-line shell through 3.54.1 contains a command injection vulnerability in the .recover command that emits attacker-planted dot-commands stored in sqlite_schema.sql values verbatim. Attackers can craft a database whose schema holds a valid CREATE statement followed by a .shell or .system line, executing OS commands when victims pipe .recover output into sqlite3.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: SQLite CLI through 3.54.1 Command Injection via .recover Output

cna.title: vsftpd through 3.0.5 require_ssl_reuse Bypass via FTPS Data Channel Hijacking

descriptions.value: vsftpd through 3.0.5 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in ssl_data_accept() that allows unauthenticated attackers to hijack FTPS data connections by resuming their own TLS session ticket. Attackers sharing the victim's source IP can obtain a ticket via AUTH TLS, then connect to the victim's PASV port to steal downloads or inject upload data.

descriptions.description: Improper Verification of Source of a Communication Channel

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: vsftpd through 3.0.5 require_ssl_reuse Bypass via FTPS Data Channel Hijacking

cna.title: vsftpd through 3.0.5 cmds_denied Bypass via RFC 775 Command Aliases

descriptions.value: vsftpd through 3.0.5 contains an access control bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated FTP users to execute denied commands by issuing RFC 775 X-prefixed aliases. The cmds_denied check in process_post_login() compares literal tokens, so attackers can send XRMD, XMKD, XCWD, XPWD, or XCUP to perform blocked operations like deleting directories.

descriptions.description: Incomplete List of Disallowed Inputs

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: vsftpd through 3.0.5 cmds_denied Bypass via RFC 775 Command Aliases

cna.title: Prometheus through 3.15.1 Credential Leak via remote_write Cross-Host Redirects

descriptions.value: Prometheus through 3.15.1 contains a credential leak vulnerability that allows attackers to capture Azure AD or Google IAM bearer tokens by redirecting remote_write requests to another host. Attackers controlling the remote-write endpoint or a redirecting server can return a 3xx to their host and replay the token, for example to write metrics to the victim's backend.

descriptions.description: Insufficiently Protected Credentials

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Prometheus through 3.15.1 Credential Leak via remote_write Cross-Host Redirects

cna.title: Plausible Analytics through 3.2.1 Mass Assignment via Traffic Change Notification Update

descriptions.value: Plausible Analytics through 3.2.1 contains a mass assignment vulnerability in update_traffic_change_notification that allows authenticated site editors to reassign notifications by supplying a site_id parameter. Attackers can submit traffic_change_notification[site_id] set to another site's primary key via PUT /sites/:domain/traffic-change-notification/:type to receive that site's traffic alerts and visitor figures.

descriptions.description: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Plausible Analytics through 3.2.1 Mass Assignment via Traffic Change Notification Update

cna.title: Plausible Analytics through 3.2.1 Site Takeover via Exposed Invitation IDs

descriptions.value: Plausible Analytics Community Edition through 3.2.1 contains an information exposure vulnerability that allows site editors to obtain pending invitation and ownership-transfer IDs from the settings/people page. Attackers can register with the invitee's email using the exposed ID and accept it, gaining the invited role or taking site ownership.

descriptions.description: Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Plausible Analytics through 3.2.1 Site Takeover via Exposed Invitation IDs

cna.title: phpMyAdmin through 5.2.3 Stored XSS via Designer Query History Table Name

descriptions.value: phpMyAdmin through 5.2.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows database users with CREATE privilege to inject script via unescaped table names in DesignerHistory.display(). Attackers can create a table whose name contains HTML markup that executes in another user's session when they add a condition on it in Designer query mode.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: phpMyAdmin through 5.2.3 Stored XSS via Designer Query History Table Name

cna.title: phpMyAdmin through 5.2.3 SQL Injection via Central Columns col_extra and col_attribute

descriptions.value: phpMyAdmin through 5.2.3 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject SQL by supplying unescaped col_extra and col_attribute values to /database/central-columns. Attackers can inject SQL into pma__central_columns INSERT and UPDATE queries run with controluser privileges, reading or modifying other users' configuration-storage data.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: phpMyAdmin through 5.2.3 SQL Injection via Central Columns col_extra and col_attribute

cna.title: phpMyAdmin through 5.2.3 WebAuthn Two-Factor Authentication Bypass via CustomServer

descriptions.value: phpMyAdmin through 5.2.3 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in CustomServer::parseAndValidateAssertionResponse() that never verifies WebAuthn assertion signatures against stored public keys. Attackers holding a victim's MySQL credentials can POST a crafted webauthn_request_response with matching challenge, origin, and rpIdHash to bypass the second factor and gain database privileges.

descriptions.description: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: phpMyAdmin through 5.2.3 WebAuthn Two-Factor Authentication Bypass via CustomServer

cna.title: OPNsense core through 26.7.8 NTP Configuration Injection via GPS and PPS Fudge Fields

descriptions.value: OPNsense core through 26.7.8 contains a configuration injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to append ntpd.conf directives by embedding newlines in the fudge and refid fields. Attackers holding the page-services-ntp-gps or PPS privilege can submit CR/LF characters via services_ntpd_gps.php or services_ntpd_pps.php to inject directives loaded by ntpd running as root.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection')

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: OPNsense core through 26.7.8 NTP Configuration Injection via GPS and PPS Fudge Fields

cna.title: OpenLiteSpeed through 1.9.4 mTLS Bypass via HTTP/3 SNI and Host Mismatch

descriptions.value: OpenLiteSpeed through 1.9.4 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to evade virtual host client certificate requirements over HTTP/3. Because QuicStream inherits a verifyContext() implementation that always returns true, attackers can present a non-mTLS host's SNI with a protected Host header to access protected content.

descriptions.description: Improper Certificate Validation

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: OpenLiteSpeed through 1.9.4 mTLS Bypass via HTTP/3 SNI and Host Mismatch

cna.title: OpenCart through 4.1.0.4 Payment Bypass via Free Checkout Reward Points

descriptions.value: OpenCart through 4.1.0.4 contains a business logic vulnerability that allows logged-in customers to place unpaid full-price orders by clearing reward points after selecting Free Checkout. Attackers can apply points, save Free Checkout, then submit zero points via reward.save so the confirm handler advances the order to Free Checkout status without payment.

descriptions.description: Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: OpenCart through 4.1.0.4 Payment Bypass via Free Checkout Reward Points

cna.title: n8n from 2.14.0 through 2.46.3 Path Traversal via Databricks Node

descriptions.value: n8n from 2.14.0 through 2.46.3 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the Databricks node that allows unauthenticated attackers to reach arbitrary Databricks API endpoints by injecting unencoded resource identifiers. Attackers can supply ../ sequences and query strings via webhook, chat, or form inputs mapped to spaceId, indexName, or filePath to read secrets using the stored credential.

descriptions.description: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: n8n from 2.14.0 through 2.46.3 Path Traversal via Databricks Node

cna.title: Moodle through 5.3.0, 5.2.4, 5.1.8, 5.0.11 and 4.5.15 Missing Authorization via core_grades_get_gradeitems

descriptions.value: Moodle 4.2.0 through 4.5.15, 5.0.0 through 5.0.11, 5.1.0 through 5.1.8, 5.2.0 through 5.2.4, and 5.3.0 contain a missing capability check in the core_grades_get_gradeitems web service that allows enrolled students to view hidden grade items. Authenticated course users can call the AJAX or mobile web service to list hidden grade item ids, names, and categories that the gradebook conceals from them.

descriptions.description: Missing Authorization

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Moodle through 5.3.0, 5.2.4, 5.1.8, 5.0.11 and 4.5.15 Missing Authorization via core_grades_get_gradeitems

cna.title: Moodle through 5.3.0, 5.2.4, 5.1.8, 5.0.11 and 4.5.15 Information Disclosure via core_grades_get_feedback

descriptions.value: Moodle 4.2.0 through 4.5.15, 5.0.0 through 5.0.11, 5.1.0 through 5.1.8, 5.2.0 through 5.2.4, and 5.3.0 contain an information disclosure vulnerability in the core_grades_get_feedback web service. The service lacks group-membership and enrolment checks, so non-editing teachers can iterate userid values to read other groups' grade feedback and users' names and identity fields such as email.

descriptions.description: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Moodle through 5.3.0, 5.2.4, 5.1.8, 5.0.11 and 4.5.15 Information Disclosure via core_grades_get_feedback

cna.title: Moodle through 5.3.0, 5.2.4, 5.1.8, 5.0.11 and 4.5.15 SQL Injection via enrol_database Course idnumber

descriptions.value: Moodle 5.3.0, 5.2.0 through 5.2.4, 5.1.0 through 5.1.8, 5.0.0 through 5.0.11, and through 4.5.15 contain an sql injection vulnerability in the External database enrolment plugin via course idnumber. Editing teachers can store a backslash-quote payload in idnumber that executes during scheduled sync on MySQL/MariaDB external databases, reading data and manipulating enrolment results.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Moodle through 5.3.0, 5.2.4, 5.1.8, 5.0.11 and 4.5.15 SQL Injection via enrol_database Course idnumber

cna.title: Moodle through 5.3.0, 5.2.4, 5.1.8, 5.0.11 and 4.5.15 Blackboard Import Path Traversal

descriptions.value: Moodle 5.3.0, 5.2.0 through 5.2.4, 5.1.0 through 5.1.8, 5.0.0 through 5.0.11, and through 4.5.15 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the Blackboard question import format. Teachers with question import or lesson edit rights can upload a crafted zip with img src values containing ../ sequences, copying server files like config.php into their draft area.

descriptions.description: Relative Path Traversal

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Moodle through 5.3.0, 5.2.4, 5.1.8, 5.0.11 and 4.5.15 Blackboard Import Path Traversal

cna.title: Uptime Kuma through 2.5.8 Race Condition Admin Creation via Setup Handler

descriptions.value: Uptime Kuma through 2.5.8 contains a race condition in the Socket.IO first-run setup handler that allows unauthenticated attackers to create an additional administrator account. Attackers can send concurrent setup requests during the bcrypt hashing window to bypass the empty user table check, then modify monitors, API keys, and enable disableAuth.

descriptions.description: Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Uptime Kuma through 2.5.8 Race Condition Admin Creation via Setup Handler

cna.title: Jellyfin through 12.4 Authorization Bypass via GET /Items/Suggestions

descriptions.value: Jellyfin through 12.4 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in SuggestionsController.GetSuggestions that allows authenticated non-administrator users to bypass library and parental restrictions by omitting the userId parameter. Attackers can repeatedly call GET /Items/Suggestions without userId to enumerate restricted items, including IDs and server filesystem paths, and then stream them.

descriptions.description: Missing Authorization

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Jellyfin through 12.4 Authorization Bypass via GET /Items/Suggestions
